Titel: Interim Project Manager SAP Ariba Rollout (m/f/d) – 100 % remote

Ort: Amsterdam
Quelle: Freelancermap

Abgerufen am: 25.09.2026 07:25

Ort: 1017 Amsterdam, Niederlande // Remote: 100 % // Vertragsart: Freiberuflich // Start: 01.11.2026 // Dauer: 8 Monate // Auslastung: 100 %

Projektbeschreibung
Our client, a Dutch food and beverage group with production sites in the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany and Poland (EUR 2.3 billion revenue), is rolling out SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing and SAP Ariba Sourcing to all European entities. Wave 1 (Netherlands and Belgium) went live in June 2026. For wave 2, covering Germany and Poland with nine legal entities, we are looking for an interim project manager.

Responsibilities
- End-to-end project management of wave 2, from fit-to-standard workshops to hypercare
- Coordination of the implementation partner, the SAP S/4HANA MM team and the local procurement organisations
- Alignment of catalogues, supplier enablement and approval workflows with the category managers
- Supplier onboarding on the Ariba Network together with accounts payable (roughly 1,400 suppliers)
- Planning and tracking of testing, training and cutover; reporting to the Chief Procurement Officer and the programme board
- Change management and communication with buyers and requisitioners in German and English

Requirements
- At least 8 years of experience in procurement or source-to-pay projects, including at least one SAP Ariba rollout in a lead role
- Good understanding of procurement processes (P2P, strategic sourcing, contract management) and of the integration with SAP MM
- Experience in manufacturing, ideally food and beverage or chemicals
- Fluent English; German is a strong plus because of the German entities
- Structured and pragmatic, used to leading remote teams

Conditions
- 100 % remote from the Netherlands, Belgium or Germany; site visits only on request, expenses reimbursed
- Daily rate: 800 - 850 EUR, invoicing via Veldkamp Interim Partners, payment term 30 days
- Freelance assignment only, no employment or staffing arrangement

Contact: Joost van Riel, Senior Consultant
